vaegbeklaedning-krydsfiner.name: Plywood wall cladding
vaegbeklaedning-krydsfiner.intro: Birch plywood cladding with visible edges and pigmented oil, also used to close installation walls behind a calm timber surface.
vaegbeklaedning-krydsfiner.story:
The cladding is made from full sheets of birch plywood, drawn to fit the wall, so joints and corners fall where they should. The layered edge is left visible at corners and ends and becomes part of the look.

The surface is treated with Rubio Monocoat hardwax oil, clear or pigmented, so the grain shows through. The colours are the same as on the rest of the furniture, so wall, cabinets and benches go together.

The cladding is used on ordinary walls and to close vertical installation walls, so pipes and services are hidden behind an even timber surface. At Mørkhøj School we have clad 96 m² of vertical installation walls.
vaegbeklaedning-krydsfiner.seo_title: Birch plywood wall cladding made to measure | Nem Inventar
vaegbeklaedning-krydsfiner.seo_description: Birch plywood wall cladding with visible edges and pigmented oil, also for installation walls. For example 96 m² at Mørkhøj School.

opbevaringsskab-laminat-standard.name: Tall cabinet in laminate
opbevaringsskab-laminat-standard.intro: A tall cabinet for storage or clothes in high-pressure laminate, which stands up to wear and daily cleaning. For schools, institutions and offices.
opbevaringsskab-laminat-standard.story: A tall cabinet built to measure: carcass in melamine-faced chipboard, fronts in high-pressure laminate in a colour of your choice, adjustable shelves and handles as you wish. Delivered and installed with filler strips and end panels, so the cabinet looks like part of the wall.
opbevaringsskab-laminat-standard.seo_title: Tall cabinet with shelves in laminate | Nem Inventar
opbevaringsskab-laminat-standard.seo_description: Tall cabinet built to measure, with high-pressure laminate fronts in your choice of colour and adjustable shelves. Installed flush with the wall.

koekkenvaeg-laminat-standard.name: Kitchen wall in laminate
koekkenvaeg-laminat-standard.intro: A complete kitchen wall in high-pressure laminate with a laminate worktop, for kitchenettes and staff kitchens in schools, institutions and offices.
koekkenvaeg-laminat-standard.story: A kitchen wall built to measure: overhead and base cabinets with full-extension drawers, tall cabinets for appliances, and a laminate worktop with sink and splashback. Carcass in melamine-faced chipboard, fronts in high-pressure laminate in a colour of your choice. Delivered and installed, filler strips included.
koekkenvaeg-laminat-standard.seo_title: Kitchenette and staff kitchen in laminate | Nem Inventar
koekkenvaeg-laminat-standard.seo_description: Custom kitchen wall with overhead and base cabinets, tall appliance cabinets and a laminate worktop with sink. For kitchenettes and staff kitchens.

akustikpanel-kvadrat-stof.name: Upholstered acoustic panel
akustikpanel-kvadrat-stof.intro: An acoustic panel upholstered in coloured fabric, sewn and built to measure with no minimum quantity. The cover can be replaced without replacing the whole panel.
akustikpanel-kvadrat-stof.story:
The panel softens the harsh sound in rooms with hard surfaces, such as classrooms, meeting rooms and foyers, without drawing too much attention to itself.

The panel is an acoustic board on a rigid backing board, covered in acoustic textile that is folded over the sides. We sew and install the panels, so size and colour suit the project, with no minimum quantity.

If a fabric becomes worn or dated, the cover is replaced while the rest of the panel stays on the wall.

Different shades can be mixed, so the wall gets some life without dominating the room.
akustikpanel-kvadrat-stof.seo_title: Upholstered acoustic panel made to measure | Nem Inventar
akustikpanel-kvadrat-stof.seo_description: Upholstered acoustic panel in coloured fabric, sewn and built to measure with no minimum quantity. The cover can be replaced without replacing the panel.

garderobeskab-laager-siddeniche.name: Wardrobe with lockable doors
garderobeskab-laager-siddeniche.intro: A plywood wardrobe with lockable doors and an upholstered seating niche.
garderobeskab-laager-siddeniche.story:
A plywood wardrobe with lockable doors and an upholstered seating niche, so locked storage and a place to sit are combined in one piece of furniture. The surface is oiled.

We make it for both pupils and staff, and the number of compartments is drawn to fit what you need.
garderobeskab-laager-siddeniche.seo_title: Lockable wardrobe for pupils and staff | Nem Inventar
garderobeskab-laager-siddeniche.seo_description: Plywood wardrobe with lockable doors and an upholstered seating niche. Locked storage and a place to sit in one piece of furniture, for pupils and staff.

hoejskab-krydsfiner.name: Tall cabinet in plywood
hoejskab-krydsfiner.intro: A tall cabinet built entirely in plywood: carcass, shelves, back and doors. The doors can be oiled, stained or faced with HPL.
hoejskab-krydsfiner.story:
The cabinet is plywood all the way through, not only on the doors. Sides, top and bottom, shelves and back are cut from the same board as the doors. The edges can therefore be left visible, and the whole cabinet can be oiled and repaired on site.

We build in birch plywood or pine plywood. The doors can be left in oiled wood, stained in a colour so the grain still shows, or faced with high-pressure laminate with a visible plywood edge.

For Hou School we are building wardrobes with carcass and doors in pine plywood, and for a sports park in Copenhagen a tall cabinet for the freezer in the same board.
hoejskab-krydsfiner.seo_title: Tall plywood cabinet for schools | Nem Inventar
hoejskab-krydsfiner.seo_description: Tall cabinet with carcass, shelves and doors in birch or pine plywood. Doors oiled, stained or HPL-faced. Built to measure for schools and institutions.

garderobeskab-perforerede-lager.name: Wardrobes with perforated doors
garderobeskab-perforerede-lager.intro: A continuous row of plywood wardrobes with perforated doors and no handles. Closed top frieze, open shoe compartments at the bottom and an integrated oak bench.
garderobeskab-perforerede-lager.story:
The wardrobes are built as one continuous row, not as single cabinets placed side by side. That means fewer joints and a calm look.

The wardrobes are birch plywood treated with pigmented hardwax oil in the colour you choose. The colour is semi-transparent, so the grain and the layers of the plywood show through.

The doors have no handles and open with a push. There is nothing to break off or catch on clothes, and the perforation lets air through. The doors can be prepared for numbers or name plates.

The unit is finished with a closed top frieze and an integrated bench in solid oak. Under the bench are open shoe compartments, so the shoes are kept off the floor.
garderobeskab-perforerede-lager.seo_title: School wardrobes with perforated doors | Nem Inventar
garderobeskab-perforerede-lager.seo_description: Continuous row of plywood wardrobes with perforated doors and no handles, a closed top frieze, open shoe compartments and an integrated oak bench.

omklaedningsmoebel-gitterskaerm.name: Changing unit with grille screen
omklaedningsmoebel-gitterskaerm.intro: A changing unit clad in high-pressure laminate, with a grille screen and a seat. The modules can be replaced one by one.
omklaedningsmoebel-gitterskaerm.story:
The unit combines storage, a bench and a grille screen that divides the room without shutting out air and light.

All surfaces are faced with high-pressure laminate, which stands up to moisture and daily cleaning, and the unit stands on adjustable legs. It is built from modules, so a damaged part can be replaced without replacing the whole unit.
omklaedningsmoebel-gitterskaerm.seo_title: Changing unit with grille screen and bench | Nem Inventar
omklaedningsmoebel-gitterskaerm.seo_description: Changing unit in MDF with HPL laminate, a grille screen and a seat. Replaceable modules for sports halls and schools.

hoejskab-kompaktlaminat.name: Tall cabinet in compact laminate
hoejskab-kompaktlaminat.intro: A tall cabinet for bathrooms and wet rooms with visible surfaces in compact laminate, which does not absorb water. Made to measure.
hoejskab-kompaktlaminat.story:
The cabinet is built for rooms with water and moisture: bathrooms, wet rooms, nappy-changing rooms and changing rooms. The visible surfaces are compact laminate, which is solid high-pressure laminate and does not swell when water reaches the edges.

Shelves, doors and lock are adapted to the use, and the cabinet can stand on a plinth or on adjustable legs, so you can clean underneath it.

We have delivered 230 bathroom cabinets in compact laminate to Bølholmen in Stenløse, and we are making tall cabinets for the wet rooms at Vinge daycare centre.
hoejskab-kompaktlaminat.seo_title: Compact laminate tall cabinet for wet rooms | Nem Inventar
hoejskab-kompaktlaminat.seo_description: Tall cabinet for bathrooms and wet rooms in compact laminate, which does not absorb water. Made to measure, e.g. for Bølholmen and Vinge daycare centre.

lockerskab-omklaedning.name: Locker cabinet for changing rooms
lockerskab-omklaedning.intro: A freestanding plywood locker cabinet with many small compartments in five tiers, each with a hasp for a padlock. For changing rooms in sports halls and swimming pools.
lockerskab-omklaedning.story:
The cabinet stands freely on the floor, so it can be placed in the middle of the changing room or against a wall. The small compartments are for valuables, clothes and shoes, and each compartment is closed with the user's own padlock.

Carcass and doors are plywood, oiled in one of our eight colours.

We draw the cabinet to fit the number of compartments you need and the space in the room.
lockerskab-omklaedning.seo_title: Plywood locker cabinet for changing rooms | Nem Inventar
lockerskab-omklaedning.seo_description: Freestanding plywood locker cabinet with small compartments and padlock hasps. For sports hall and swimming pool changing rooms, oiled in eight colours.

lockers-krydsfiner.name: Plywood lockers
lockers-krydsfiner.intro: Plywood lockers in two tiers with plain doors and locks. For changing rooms, sports halls and staff rooms.
lockers-krydsfiner.story:
The lockers stand in two tiers, one above the other, so a wall holds twice as many places. Each locker has its own door with a lock, and the doors are plain, without holes.

Carcass and doors are plywood, oiled in one of our eight colours. Wear and scratches can be sanded and re-oiled on site.

We draw the row to fit the length of the wall and the number of places you need.
lockers-krydsfiner.seo_title: Plywood lockers for changing rooms | Nem Inventar
lockers-krydsfiner.seo_description: Plywood lockers in two tiers with plain doors and locks, oiled in eight colours. Made to measure for changing rooms, sports halls and staff rooms.

hoejskab-aaben-reol.name: Tall cabinets with open shelving
hoejskab-aaben-reol.intro: Tall plywood cabinets with an open shelf section between the closed cabinets. The carcass and shelves are in clear oil, and the doors are oiled in one of our eight colours.
hoejskab-aaben-reol.story:
The cabinet is plywood all the way through. In the middle of the row is an open shelf section for books, folders and the things you want close at hand, with closed cabinets with doors on each side.

Carcass, shelves and open section are in clear oil, so the layers of the plywood show in the edges. The doors are oiled in one of our eight colours, or in clear oil like the rest of the cabinet.

We draw the cabinet to the dimensions of the room, so the number of cabinets and the width of the open section fit the wall.
hoejskab-aaben-reol.seo_title: Plywood tall cabinet with open shelving | Nem Inventar
hoejskab-aaben-reol.seo_description: Plywood tall cabinet with open shelving between closed cabinets. Clear-oiled carcass, doors in eight colours. Made to measure for schools and institutions.

hoejskab-hpl-laager.name: Tall cabinet with laminate doors
hoejskab-hpl-laager.intro: A tall cabinet with a carcass in clear oiled plywood and MDF doors faced with high-pressure laminate (HPL). The doors come in seven colours from Arpa's Bloom HPL range.
hoejskab-hpl-laager.story:
Carcass, shelves and plinth are plywood in clear oil, so the layers of the board show in the edges. The doors are MDF faced with high-pressure laminate, a hard, plain-coloured surface with no grain that stands up to cleaning and daily use.

The laminate is Arpa HPL Bloom, with a core based on lignin from wood. We show seven colours, and the range has more.

We draw the cabinet to the dimensions of the room, so the number of doors and shelves fits the wall.
hoejskab-hpl-laager.seo_title: Tall cabinet with HPL doors | Nem Inventar
hoejskab-hpl-laager.seo_description: Plywood tall cabinet with doors in MDF and high-pressure laminate (Arpa HPL Bloom) in seven colours. Built to measure for schools and institutions.

opbevaringsskab-bejdset-krydsfiner.name: Tall cabinet with stained plywood doors
opbevaringsskab-bejdset-krydsfiner.intro: A tall cabinet with stained plywood doors that show the grain and the edge.
opbevaringsskab-bejdset-krydsfiner.story: The same sturdy build as the tall cabinet in laminate, but the fronts are plywood treated with pigmented hardwax oil that lets the grain show through. The visible plywood edge becomes part of the look. Colours such as natural, red, blue or smoked.
opbevaringsskab-bejdset-krydsfiner.seo_title: Stained plywood tall cabinet made to measure | Nem Inventar
opbevaringsskab-bejdset-krydsfiner.seo_description: Tall cabinet with doors in stained plywood and pigmented hardwax oil that lets the grain show through. Visible edge. Built to measure.

koekkenvaeg-bejdset-krydsfiner.name: Kitchen wall with stained plywood fronts
koekkenvaeg-bejdset-krydsfiner.intro: A kitchen wall with fronts in stained plywood that show the grain and the edge.
koekkenvaeg-bejdset-krydsfiner.story: The same build as the kitchen wall in laminate, but all fronts are plywood with pigmented hardwax oil and a visible edge. Usually combined with a light laminate worktop and a steel sink. Colours such as natural, red, blue or smoked.
koekkenvaeg-bejdset-krydsfiner.seo_title: Kitchenette with stained plywood fronts | Nem Inventar
koekkenvaeg-bejdset-krydsfiner.seo_description: Kitchen wall with fronts in stained plywood with visible grain and edge, a laminate worktop and a steel sink. For schools and staff kitchens.

omklaedningsbaenk-integreret-knagerakke.name: Changing-room bench with coat hooks
omklaedningsbaenk-integreret-knagerakke.intro: A continuous bench with backrest and a row of coat hooks in a steel rail, built as one element along the wall. Oiled wood that can be repaired locally.
omklaedningsbaenk-integreret-knagerakke.story:
We build the bench as one continuous element, with seat, backrest and coat hooks joined along the wall.

The wood is oiled, so it stands up to moisture, sports bags and daily use, and wear can be repaired locally. The hooks sit in a steel rail built into the backrest, so they cannot be unscrewed.
omklaedningsbaenk-integreret-knagerakke.seo_title: Changing-room bench with coat hooks | Nem Inventar
omklaedningsbaenk-integreret-knagerakke.seo_description: Changing-room bench with integrated coat hooks, built to measure for changing rooms in sports halls, swimming pools and schools.

garderobereol-siddenicher.name: Open wardrobe with seating niches
garderobereol-siddenicher.intro: An open plywood wardrobe unit with upholstered seating niches.
garderobereol-siddenicher.story: An open plywood wardrobe with two upholstered seating niches. Finished with Rubio Monocoat. Developed for school cloakrooms, where children need to see and reach their own things and also have somewhere to sit, for example to change shoes or pack clothes into or out of their bag.
garderobereol-siddenicher.seo_title: Children's cloakroom with seating niches | Nem Inventar
garderobereol-siddenicher.seo_description: Open plywood wardrobe with upholstered seating niches, so children can see and reach their things and sit down while they change shoes.

skohylde-siddeplads.name: Open shoe rack with seat
skohylde-siddeplads.intro: An open plywood shoe rack with an integrated seat.
skohylde-siddeplads.story: An open plywood shoe rack with an integrated seat. Finished with Rubio Monocoat. Made low, so it works both as storage and as a bench in cloakroom areas.
skohylde-siddeplads.seo_title: Shoe rack with seat for cloakrooms | Nem Inventar
skohylde-siddeplads.seo_description: Low, open plywood shoe rack with an integrated seat that works both as storage and as a bench in cloakroom areas.

lockerskab-ventilerede-laager.name: Lockers with ventilated doors
lockerskab-ventilerede-laager.intro: Tall plywood lockers where each door has a field of holes at the top and bottom, so air can pass through. For changing rooms, staff rooms and cloakrooms.
lockerskab-ventilerede-laager.story:
The holes sit in two fields on each door, at the top and at the bottom, so moisture from clothes, shoes and kit can get out, also when the door is closed. Inside there is a shelf, hooks and room for shoes at the bottom.

The cabinet is plywood all the way through and is oiled in one of our eight colours.

We draw the lockers to the dimensions of the room and the number of places you need.
lockerskab-ventilerede-laager.seo_title: Plywood lockers with ventilated doors | Nem Inventar
lockerskab-ventilerede-laager.seo_description: Tall plywood lockers with holes at the top and bottom of the doors, so air can pass through. Oiled in eight colours, built to measure.

lockers-med-baenke.name: Lockers with benches
lockers-med-baenke.intro: Plywood lockers in two tiers with a bench with backrest and cushion after each section. For school corridors, cloakrooms and changing rooms.
lockers-med-baenke.story:
The lockers stand in sections of three columns and two tiers, and after each section there is a bench with backrest and cushion. You can sit down and change shoes right by your own locker.

Carcass, benches and plinth are plywood with clear oil. The doors are oiled in one of our eight colours, so the row can follow the school's colours.

We draw the row to fit the length of the wall and the number of places you need.
lockers-med-baenke.seo_title: School lockers with benches | Nem Inventar
lockers-med-baenke.seo_description: Plywood lockers with a bench with backrest and cushion after each section. Doors in eight colours. Drawn to fit your wall and made in our own production.

mobil-lockers-krydsfiner.name: Phone lockers in plywood
mobil-lockers-krydsfiner.intro: For schools that collect phones, and for changing rooms in sports halls where valuables need locking away. Thirty small compartments in one narrow cabinet, with a hasp for a padlock on each door.
mobil-lockers-krydsfiner.story:
The phone locker is a narrow cabinet with many small compartments, each with its own door. The version in the pictures has three compartments across and ten high. We build it to measure: more columns, more compartments or larger compartments if there also has to be room for a wallet and keys.

The cabinet has no plinth. It stands on small feet and is fixed to the wall. Each door has a chrome turn lock with an eye for the user's own padlock, so the door is opened and locked in the same place. The doors can also have a cylinder lock or a code lock.

It is built in plywood with visible edge layers and oiled in clear oil or one of our colours. The oil can be spot-repaired, so a scratch does not mean a new door.

In our 3D designer you can choose the number of compartments, the dimensions and the colour, and download an IFC file for your drawing.
mobil-lockers-krydsfiner.seo_title: Phone lockers for schools and changing rooms | Nem Inventar
mobil-lockers-krydsfiner.seo_description: Narrow plywood locker cabinet with 30 small compartments for phones and valuables. Padlock hasps, no plinth, built to measure and oiled in eight colours.

akustikpaneler-perforeret-krydsfiner.name: Perforated plywood acoustic panels
akustikpaneler-perforeret-krydsfiner.intro: Pine or birch plywood panels with holes and acoustic felt behind. For classrooms, music rooms, sports halls and canteens, where the wall has to dampen sound and stand up to balls and chairs.
akustikpaneler-perforeret-krydsfiner.hero_tagline: A timber surface that dampens sound.
akustikpaneler-perforeret-krydsfiner.story:
The panels are plywood boards with a pattern of holes. Behind the board is a cavity with acoustic felt or mineral wool. Sound passes through the holes and is absorbed behind them, so the reverberation in the room drops.

The hole pattern is chosen to meet the acoustician's requirements. Surfaces that do not need to absorb sound are made in the same board without holes, so the wall looks the same all the way along.

We also agree the cavity behind with the acoustician, so the room meets its reverberation time requirement. The panels are installed with shadow gaps and can be designed to come down if there needs to be access to services behind them.

The panels are oiled in clear oil or one of our colours, so they can match the rest of the furniture.
akustikpaneler-perforeret-krydsfiner.seo_title: Perforated plywood acoustic panels | Nem Inventar
akustikpaneler-perforeret-krydsfiner.seo_description: Plywood acoustic wall panels with holes. Designed to the acoustician's requirements and oiled in eight colours.
